card.description: A towering 30-meter granite obelisk, etched with Ethiopian and Egyptian hieroglyphs that glow with bioluminescent blue light, housing a crystalline core that hums with unseen power
visual_anatomy: **Body/Form:** 30m tall granite monolith, tapering to a pointed apex, base carved with stone reliefs of ancient deities
**Face/Sensors:** Surface etched with luminous glyphs; embedded crystal arrays pulse with soft blue light, acting as sensor conduits
**Key Features:** Central crystalline core, bioluminescent glyph veins, stone carvings that shift subtly when energy flows
evolution: Phase 1 (Activation): The crystalline core begins to glow, glyphs pulse in a rhythmic pattern, faint dust motes rise
Phase 2 (Full Operation): Core emits steady luminescence, glyphs flare brighter, stone carvings shift to reveal hidden inscriptions, energy flows visibly through crystalline veins
